patterns-card.name: CardComponent
patterns-card.description:
A block of related content, alone or in a grid: a title, text, chips, and an action, each projected. The heading is the title, the `

` the text, each `` a chip, and the `` the action, so whoever places it picks the heading level. The card draws them in that order, whatever their order in the source. A card is not a control, so it takes no focus and emits nothing. The styles reach the projected children, which emulated encapsulation leaves out, so the component turns encapsulation off and scopes every rule to its own selector instead.
